description: This file contains a Zephyr RTOS application demonstrating inter-process communication (IPC) using multiple endpoints and threads. It sets up three IPC instances with endpoints, handles message sending and receiving, and manages synchronization with semaphores.

methods.name: ipc0A_ept_bound
methods.description: Callback invoked when endpoint A (instance 0) is bound.

methods.name: ipc0A_ept_recv
methods.description: Callback invoked when endpoint A (instance 0) receives data.

methods.name: ipc0A_entry
methods.description: Thread function for IPC instance 0 endpoint A, handles message sending.

methods.description: Callback invoked when endpoint B (instance 0) is bound.

methods.name: ipc0B_ept_recv
methods.description: Callback invoked when endpoint B (instance 0) receives data.

methods.name: ipc0B_entry
methods.description: Thread function for IPC instance 0 endpoint B, handles message sending.
